question: Should OpenClaw permanently admit exact allowlisted, already-active `workspace-directory` plugins and their owned apps into native Codex turns?
rationale: The implementation partially revisits a recent curated-only boundary decision and expands persisted remote plugin/app trust; code correctness cannot authorize that permanent product and security choice.

options.title: Approve narrow workspace support
options.body: Allow only exact configured workspace identities with no OpenClaw install authority and the existing default-deny app and approval policy.

options.title: Keep curated-only support
options.body: Reject the added marketplace and preserve the current native Codex plugin trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow workspace support
recommendation.body: Allow only exact configured workspace identities with no OpenClaw install authority and the existing default-deny app and approval policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work directly restored and documented the current curated-only boundary in the affected modules.
